corpus.filter: index row type=='diagram' and subtype=='architecture' and aesthetic=='good' (727 records at selection time, 2026-09-07; the corpus holds 726 after sosp25-047_fig4 was reclassified to mechanism on 2026-09-09)

layout: <template>/index.json lists that template's exemplars (architecture); mechanism/<group>/index.json lists a v3 group's exemplars (mechanism); figures/<id>/{source.svg, preview.png?, print.png?, semantics.json, manifest.json} holds each figure once, manifest.kind says which kind it is
provenance: Figures are reproduced from published OSDI/NSDI/SOSP/ASPLOS papers for style reference only.

corpus.filter: record kind == 'mechanism' and index row diagram/mechanism/good; candidates = mech-prescreen/semantics/candidate_ids.txt
